version.changelog:
cosercard-skill v1.0.1

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No new features, bug fixes, or documentation updates were introduced.
- Version increment for administrative or metadata purposes only.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its purpose (a local Python image-layout tool); it has no surprising external dependencies or credential requests, but it persistently stores usage/profile data (including optional contact/social fields) in a local learning_data.json which is a privacy consideration.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the files and behaviour: a Python tool using Pillow to load user photos, arrange layouts and render export images. Declared dependencies (Pillow) and provided scripts align with the stated functionality. No extraneous cloud or unrelated credentials/binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent/user to run the included script and to provide photos and optional personal info (name, body measurements, social handles, contact). The instructions remain within the stated purpose (image generation/layout). Notably, the runtime flow records configurations and preferences to a local learning_data.json as part of the 'learning' feature — this means personal/social/contact information and photo filenames can be stored locally. There are no instructions to read arbitrary system files or to send data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec in the registry; the code is instruction+script-only. Dependencies are installed via pip (Pillow) which is appropriate for a Python image utility. No downloads from untrusted URLs or archive extraction are present in the packaging or SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request environment variables, credentials, or system config paths. Required inputs are file paths to user photos and optional profile fields. There are no unrelated secrets or broad environment access demands.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill persistently stores usage history, preferences and marked 'best' configurations in learning_data.json inside the skill directory. This is coherent with the 'self-evolving' feature but means local persistence of potentially sensitive user-provided fields (names, contact/social info, photo file names). The skill does not request always:true and does not modify other skills/system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it claims: a local Python image/layout tool. Before installing or running it, consider: (1) it stores a local learning_data.json that records profile fields, social handles and output filenames — avoid entering sensitive contact info if you don't want it saved; (2) run pip install in a virtualenv or sandbox and inspect scripts (scripts/coser_card.py) if you have privacy concerns; (3) the tool reads photo file paths you provide — ensure you point it only at photos you intend to process; (4) there are no network calls detected in the package, but if you modify the code or add plugins, re-check for any outbound network access. If you want to avoid persistence, you can delete or move learning_data.json or modify the script to disable saving preferences.
